g.text: Mixed-adapter LoRA batching for diffusion serving
Gap: no open-source diffusion engine puts requests that use different LoRAs into one batch
the adapter is part of the batch key: one adapter per batch
blank = base model, A-D = different LoRAs
switching adapters between batches means merge/unmerge or
re-activation; small batches leave small models underused
adapter id is per-row metadata, not part of the batch key
base and LoRA requests share batches; requests join and
leave between denoise steps; adapter weights never touch W
→ different adapters run in separate batches
one LoRA config active per target;
kill test kernel: ≤5% overhead vs base (vLLM-Omni wrapper today: +12–30%) · system: ≥1.5× throughput or ≥2× better P99 on trace replay
